prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: diffuse texture for the horizontal cut end of a weathered oak harbour mooring pile, used on a 3D game model.
Create a perfectly flat orthographic cross-polarized photograph of exposed old oak end grain, filling the entire square image. The growth-ring centre is near the image centre. The entire square must be wood, with no circular silhouette or background; it is cropped from the middle of a larger log end. About 32 cm of wood across the image. Closely spaced irregular annual rings, fine porous fibres, a few naturally tapering radial checks and slightly worn grey surface. Real oak, not a drawn ring pattern.
Muted weathered grey-brown palette matching aged dark harbour timber, with no orange new lumber. Subtle remaining dark tar stains, but visible grain. Uniform neutral diffuse illumination; no glossy highlights, shadows, directional lighting or baked ambient occlusion.
No text, watermark, borders, objects, hardware, bark, perspective, cutout or side grain. Opaque colour texture only.
